title: Professional Service Contract – Sports Management Resources – General Counsel
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Sports Management Resources, Shelton, CT, for the latter to assess and provide District with an analysis and recommendations to address any issues relating to the benefits and treatment of District female student participation in athletics, including tasks that may include, but not limited to, reviewing participation data in athletic programs, assessing District athletic facilities, conducting workshops for relevant District personnel, and creating annual surveys of female student interest in athletics, for the period March 25, 2020 through March 25, 2021, in an amount not to exceed $30,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $30,000 for Sports Management Resources to review girls' athletics
summary: The Board ratifies a one-year contract with Sports Management Resources, a Connecticut firm, to assess how the district treats female student athletes and recommend changes. Work includes reviewing participation data, assessing athletic facilities, running workshops for staff and surveying girls' interest in sports. The contract runs March 25, 2020 through March 25, 2021 and costs no more than $30,000.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
